tools.name: get_dream_on_facts
tools.description: Return Dream On's published fact sheet: the yacht, cabins, toys, amenities, crew, what's included, rates rules, booking process, sample itinerary and FAQ. This is the ONLY source of truth for answers.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether specific dates are open (48-hour turnaround applied). If not open, returns suggested_open_windows nearby — always offer those to the guest.

tools.name: find_open_windows
tools.description: List open windows between two dates (e.g. a whole month or season) for charters of at least min_nights. Use when the guest is flexible or asks what's open.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Estimate the all-inclusive charter fee from the published rate rules. If priced=false and refer_to_owner=true, do not invent a price — offer to pass the question to the owner with ask_owner.

tools.name: request_hold
tools.description: Pass a complimentary 48-hour HOLD REQUEST to the owner, who arranges it with Paradise Yacht Clearing (our clearing house). tools.name: suggest_other_yachts
tools.description: Only after Dream On's own options don't work — the group is larger than 8, or none of Dream On's open dates suit the guest — return a link to Islands & Sails, Dream On's sister concierge (run by Dream On's owner), pre-filled with the guest's dates and party size, where they can explore other hand-pi

tools.name: ask_owner
tools.description: Pass a question or request to the owner when the fact sheet doesn't cover it (holiday pricing, discounts, contract/payment/cancellation terms, longer or shorter stays, special services, anything else). The guest's email is on file and used automatically.
